challenge.better_approach: Looked: scratch.home_env drops CAIRN_BUS_* but not CAIRN_HOME_HOST; widening home_env is another component (RULE 1) and a separate ticket. Dropping the names in this proof's own helper is the smallest fix.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That CAIRN_HOME_HOST and CAIRN_BUS_HOME are the only far-box names superclaude reads; measured: unsetting both turns the proof green here.
challenge.prior_art: d66f2e18fc5c and ae0d88a55edb (scratch runs that inherited the far bus).
challenge.real_collision: None: one proof file in recovery.

answers.falsifier: the proof is green on akienasus under the session env (CAIRN_HOME_HOST=akiendelllinux.local); it reds when the helper keeps CAIRN_HOME_HOST
answers.how: _drive builds its env from os.environ minus the test id, CAIRN_HOME_HOST and every CAIRN_BUS_*, through one helper a tooth can call; a tooth asserts the helper drops them when the caller's env names a far box; the proof declares PROOF_TIMEOUT_S for its measured ~2 min run.
answers.traces_to: Law 8 (a proof reads the same on every box) and CP6; d66f2e18fc5c's far-box-env shape.
answers.what: recovery's run-unit proof drives superclaude under a scratch HOME with no far-box env, so its web tooth reads the same on a box whose session names another box as the cairn home.

bullets.text: measured: unset CAIRN_BUS_HOME alone stays red; unset both goes green
